title: Todd Monken: Shedeur Sanders in line to be Browns backup QB vs. Jaguars

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Todd Monken: Shedeur Sanders in line to be Browns backup QB vs. Jaguars
sources.description: Browns head coach Todd Monken raised some eyebrows earlier this week when he said it's possible the team may use Taylen Green for a package of plays while also acknowledging that it would be difficult to have three QBs active on the gameday roster.
